questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of force is the newton.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which gas is used by humans during aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is used in aerobic respiration.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: What is the boiling point of water at standard atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Food energy is primarily stored in the form of which type of chemical energy?
questions.explanation: Food stores energy in chemical bonds.
